q: President Droupadi Murmu approved Regulation 235 primarily in connection with which of the following?
options: Establishment of a new district in Ladakh
Establishment of High Court sittings in Ladakh
Creation of a separate Supreme Court Bench in Ladakh
Establishment of a new High Court for Ladakh
explanation: Regulation 235 approved the establishment of High Court sittings within the Union Territory of Ladakh to improve access to judicial facilities.

q: Which of the following statements regarding the High Court sittings in Ladakh is correct?
options: The initiative is intended to improve access to judicial facilities.
The initiative creates a separate Supreme Court for Ladakh.
The initiative abolishes the existing judicial system in Ladakh.
The initiative establishes a new district in Ladakh.
explanation: The initiative aims to bring judicial services closer to the people of Ladakh and improve access to justice.
